title: Card
description: One card in the catalog. Used both for the card history input (every card a rule cares about) and for recommendations. Draft: field names may change while the engine is built.

recommendable.description: False for cards that only exist in the history list because they count toward a rule (for example 5/24) or are no longer offered.

annualFee.description: Raw annual fee in USD. Required unless the card is history-only (recommendable false).

firstYearFeeWaived.description: True if the first year's fee is waived. Displayed as 'Annual fee of $X, waived the first year'; ranking and the annual fee limit use the first-year fee, so a waived first year counts as $0.

reportsToPersonal.description: Whether the card appears on the personal credit report and counts toward X/24 style rules.

chargeCard.description: Amex charge cards count toward the 10 charge card limit, not the 5 credit card limit.

currency.description: id from currencies.json. Use 'cash' for plain cash back.

coBrandedProgram.description: id from programs.json for airline or hotel co-branded cards.

bonusTypes.description: What the card earns, used for the 'bonus types wanted' filter. A transferable currency is listed as 'transferable'; the engine expands it to airline and hotel from the currency's partners.

unlocksTransfers.description: True if holding this card unlocks transfers for its currency (for example Sapphire Preferred). See currencies.json.

requiresAAAccess.description: True for AAdvantage cards; hidden for players banned from AA.

id.description: Family id: Amex (mr-personal, cash, delta-personal, delta-business, hilton) or Capital One (venture).

tier.description: 1 is lowest. Having ever had a higher tier blocks the bonus on lower tiers.

onceInLifetime.description: Blocked if you have ever been approved for this exact card (approval-based, not bonus-based).

cooldownMonths.description: Months to wait: 24 (Chase, BoA, Southwest, IHG) or 48 (Citi, Capital One personal). Only these two lengths are allowed because the engine reads windows from the count buckets (under 12, 12 to 24, 24 to 48 months).

marriottMatrixKey.description: Row and column key into the Marriott matrix (docs rule audit Section H).

lifetimeAlsoBlockedBy.description: Other cards whose past approval also blocks this bonus for life (Strata is blocked by Strata Student, Strata Premier by Citi Premier).

cooldownBasis.description: 'bonus': the clock runs from the date the bonus was received. 'held': from the last day you held the card (BoA).

cooldownFamily.description: Cards sharing a family id share one clock and one holding test: holding any of them, or a bonus on any of them inside the window, blocks all of them (southwest-personal, ihg-personal).

blockedWhileHeld.description: No bonus while you currently hold this card (the card family, if cooldownFamily is set).

typicalMinSpend.description: Spend needed for the bonus. Omitted when the offer has no spend requirement (for example the Prime Visa gift card).

welcomeBonus.description: Typical welcome bonus, used for value ranking: value = points x cents-per-point (valuations.json) + cashBack + otherValue. Net ranking value = that value minus annualFee.

points.description: Points or miles in the card's own currency.

cashBack.description: Dollar value of statement credits or cash back paid as actual cash.

displayedAsCash.description: Dollar figure shown to users when the issuer advertises the bonus as cash back but actually awards points (for example Ink Business Cash: $750 shown, awarded as Ultimate Rewards). When set, put the points in `points` (and the card's `currency`), not in `cashBack`.

otherValue.description: Dollar value the maintainer assigns to other components, such as free night certificates.

additionalTiers.description: Extra bonus tiers (for example Aeroplan's second spend threshold). The engine adds them when the household's spending meets the first threshold.

ceiling.description: True when the issuer shows an 'as high as' ceiling (Amex) rather than a fixed offer. Many applicants get less; the methodology page says so.

freeNights.description: Number of free night certificates in the bonus, for display. Their dollar value is in otherValue.

rank.description: Position in each flowchart list (1 is best). Omit a list the card is not in. Kept alongside welcomeBonus while the flowchart-list ranking and the value ranking are compared; one will be dropped later.

sourceUrl.description: Issuer page the annual fee and minimum spend were checked against.

unrankedReason.description: Present when the card cannot be given a bonus value (its points have no valuation, or the offer has no fixed amount). The card is left out of the value ranking.
